legal_gate_record_blocked_chk.name: legal_gate_record_blocked_chk
legal_gate_record_blocked_chk.value: "legal_gate_record"."outcome" <> 'blocked' or ("legal_gate_record"."constraint_text" is not null and "legal_gate_record"."source_ref" is not null and jsonb_path_exists("legal_gate_record"."findings", '$[*] ? (@.blocks == true && exists(@.layer) && @.article_ids.size() > 0)'))

moderation_decision_span_chk.name: moderation_decision_span_chk
moderation_decision_span_chk.value: ("moderation_decision"."span_start" is null and "moderation_decision"."span_end" is null) or ("moderation_decision"."span_start" is not null and "moderation_decision"."span_end" is not null and "moderation_decision"."span_start" < "moderation_decision"."span_end")

moderation_decision_explain_chk.name: moderation_decision_explain_chk
moderation_decision_explain_chk.value: "moderation_decision"."outcome" not in ('needs_revision','reject','rejected') or ("moderation_decision"."field_ref" is not null and ("moderation_decision"."revision_hint" is not null or "moderation_decision"."safety_sensitive"))

moderation_run_held_chk.name: moderation_run_held_chk
moderation_run_held_chk.value: "moderation_run"."status" <> 'held' or ("moderation_run"."held_reason" is not null and "moderation_run"."held_reason" in ('provider_timeout','schema_invalid','low_confidence','language_unsupported','pack_missing','budget_exhausted','canary_tripped','gateway_failure','policy_conflict'))

review_recommendation_resolved_chk.name: review_recommendation_resolved_chk
review_recommendation_resolved_chk.value: "review_recommendation"."status" = 'open' or ("review_recommendation"."resolution_reason" is not null and "review_recommendation"."resolved_at" is not null)
